fusions.name: Pounding Surge
fusions.desc: Tramples every enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage and knocks it back 3 tiles, each with a 50% chance of [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Sprint Snatch
fusions.desc: A snapping bite that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Open Water Run
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% and your dodge chance by 10% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Stride
fusions.desc: You move 12% faster and have 8% water resistance.
